title: Mass of the restriction current: M_W(T⌞A) = μ(W ∩ A) (Simon 6.2.8–2.9, R3)
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, μ a Borel measure on ℝ^P, v : ℝ^P → NVector (Eucl P) k with x ↦ v(x)(ω(x)) μ-integrable for every ω ∈ D^k(U), μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U, |v(x)(α)| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α for all x, α, x ↦ v(x)(α) Borel for every α, and for μ-a.e. x some α with covectorEuclideanNorm α ≤ 1 and v(x)(α) = 1. Then for every Borel A ⊆ ℝ^P, every S ∈ D_k(U) with S(ω) = ∫_A v(x)(ω(x)) dμ(x) for all ω ∈ D^k(U), and every open W ⊆ U, M_W(S) = μ(W ∩ A) in [0, ∞].
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (v : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) k), (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, Integrable (fun x => v x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x)) μ) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → (∀ (x : Eucl P) (α : Covector (Eucl P) k), |v x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ α : Covector (Eucl P) k, Measurable (fun x => v x α)) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∃ α : Covector (Eucl P) k, covectorEuclideanNorm α ≤ 1 ∧ v x α = 1) → ∀ A : Set (Eucl P), MeasurableSet A → ∀ S : GeometricCurrentOn U k, (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, S ω = ∫ x in A, v x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x) ∂μ) → ∀ W : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → S.massOn W = μ (W ∩ A)
